vietnam.title: Flag of Vietnam

colors.note: Represents revolution and the blood shed for independence
Represents the soul and spirit of the nation

desc: - A large yellow five-pointed star centred on a red field. The five points represent intellectuals, farmers, workers, entrepreneurs, and soldiers
trivia:
- The single gold star represents the unity of Vietnam under communist leadership
- The red represents the struggle for independence and communism
- Vietnam adopted this flag in 1955 for North Vietnam; it became the flag of united Vietnam in 1975
